categories.name: Fresh Vegetables
categories.desc: Farm-fresh staples graded for size, colour and shelf life — cooled and packed for long journeys.

categories.name: Fresh Fruits
categories.desc: All-natural fruit from India's celebrated orchards, harvested at the right maturity for export.

categories.name: Spices
categories.desc: Whole spices bought at the source markets that set India's prices — cleaned, sorted and graded.

categories.name: Herbs
categories.desc: Culinary and Ayurvedic herbs — fresh leaves and dried roots — from their traditional growing belts.

categories.name: Powders
categories.desc: Spices and dehydrated produce milled from origin-sourced raw material, packed retail-ready or in bulk.

products.name: Onion
products.desc: Firm, well-cured bulbs with tight necks and bright, dry skins.
products.story: Lasalgaon, near Nashik, is home to Asia's largest onion market. We buy from this belt where the crop is cured and sorted for long sea routes.

products.name: Tomato
products.desc: Even-coloured, firm tomatoes picked at the right ripeness for transit.
products.story: Kolar's mandi is one of South India's busiest tomato markets, drawing fruit from across Karnataka's growing belt.

products.name: Potato
products.desc: Clean, well-skinned tubers sorted for size and free from greening.
products.story: Uttar Pradesh is India's largest potato-producing state, and the Agra belt is one of its main cold-storage hubs.

products.name: Green Chilli
products.desc: Glossy green chillies with firm flesh and a clean, sharp heat.
products.story: Guntur is India's chilli heartland — the same soils that grow its famous dried reds supply fresh green chillies year-round.

products.name: Garlic
products.desc: Well-dried bulbs with tight cloves and clean, intact skins.
products.story: The Mandsaur–Neemuch region of Madhya Pradesh is one of India's largest garlic-trading belts.

products.name: Ginger
products.desc: Plump, fibrous-free rhizomes with a sharp, aromatic bite.
products.story: Kerala's high-rainfall hills, including Wayanad, have grown ginger for centuries — the spice that first drew traders to the Malabar coast.

products.name: Drumstick
products.desc: Tender, straight moringa pods harvested young for soft flesh.
products.story: Tamil Nadu is India's leading moringa-growing state, with the Dindigul–Theni belt among its largest producers.

products.name: Okra
products.desc: Tender, bright-green pods sorted for length and free from blemishes.
products.story: Gujarat is one of India's top okra-producing states, with central Gujarat supplying through the year.

products.name: Alphonso Mango
products.desc: The king of mangoes — saffron flesh, rich aroma, no fibre.
products.story: Ratnagiri's laterite soil and Konkan sea air give Alphonso its GI-tagged character. Season: roughly April–June.

products.name: Kesar Mango
products.desc: Saffron-hued, intensely sweet mangoes with a long shelf life.
products.story: Grown in the foothills of Girnar near Gir forest, Gir Kesar carries a GI tag. Season: roughly May–July.

products.name: Banana
products.desc: Uniform hands with clean peel, harvested green for controlled ripening.
products.story: Jalgaon is known as India's banana city and its bananas carry a GI tag — a major hub for export-grade Cavendish.

products.name: Pomegranate
products.desc: Deep-red Bhagwa fruit with glossy skin and sweet, soft-seeded arils.
products.story: Solapur's pomegranates carry a GI tag, and Bhagwa from this region is India's flagship export variety.

products.name: Grapes
products.desc: Crisp, sweet table grapes pre-cooled to keep berries firm and stems green.
products.story: Nashik produces the majority of India's table-grape exports; Nashik valley grapes carry a GI tag. Main harvest: roughly January–April.

products.name: Guava
products.desc: Fragrant, sweet guavas with smooth skin and soft white or pink flesh.
products.story: Allahabad Safeda from the Prayagraj belt is among India's best-known guava varieties.

products.name: Red Chilli — Teja S17
products.desc: Bright red, high-pungency chillies prized for colour and heat.
products.story: Teja chillies are grown around Khammam and traded through the Guntur–Khammam markets — a favourite of the oleoresin and sauce industries.

products.name: Red Chilli — Guntur Sannam S4
products.desc: The classic Guntur chilli — balanced heat and deep red colour.
products.story: Guntur Sannam carries a GI tag, and the Guntur market yard is one of the world's largest dried-chilli markets.

products.name: Turmeric
products.desc: Bright golden fingers with rich colour and a warm, earthy aroma.
products.story: Erode is often called India's turmeric city; Erode turmeric carries a GI tag.

products.name: Cumin Seeds
products.desc: Bold, aromatic seeds cleaned to the buyer's purity standard.
products.story: Unjha in north Gujarat hosts what is widely called Asia's largest cumin market — the price-setter for jeera.

products.name: Coriander Seeds
products.desc: Uniform, well-coloured seeds with a fresh citrusy aroma.
products.story: Ramganj Mandi in Rajasthan's Kota region is one of India's largest coriander markets.

products.name: Black Pepper
products.desc: Bold, pungent peppercorns from the spice coast of Kerala.
products.story: Malabar pepper is GI-tagged — the spice that drew traders to Kerala for centuries is still grown on its hill slopes.

products.name: Green Cardamom
products.desc: Plump, bright-green pods with an intense, sweet aroma.
products.story: The Cardamom Hills of Idukki grow most of India's small cardamom, sold through the e-auctions at Bodinayakanur and Puttady.

products.name: Cloves
products.desc: Well-dried, oil-rich buds with a strong, warm aroma.
products.story: The hills of Kanyakumari district, alongside Kerala, are among India's main clove-growing areas.

products.name: Moringa Leaves
products.desc: Nutrient-dense leaves, fresh or carefully shade-dried to keep their colour.
products.story: Tamil Nadu is India's moringa heartland, supplying both fresh leaves and the raw material for moringa powder.

products.name: Curry Leaves
products.desc: Glossy, aromatic sprigs — the essential tempering leaf of South Indian cooking.
products.story: Western Tamil Nadu grows curry leaf commercially for India's kitchens and the Indian diaspora worldwide.

products.name: Mint
products.desc: Fresh, fragrant leaves — supplied fresh or dried.
products.story: The Barabanki belt of Uttar Pradesh is India's largest mint-growing region.

products.name: Ashwagandha Root
products.desc: Sun-dried roots of the classic Ayurvedic herb, cleaned and graded.
products.story: The Neemuch–Mandsaur region of Madhya Pradesh is India's main ashwagandha-growing and trading belt.

products.name: Red Chilli Powder
products.desc: Milled from origin-sourced Guntur chillies for consistent colour and heat.
products.story: Ground from chillies bought at the Guntur market yard, so colour and pungency stay true to the source.

products.name: Turmeric Powder
products.desc: Bright, fine-milled turmeric made from Erode fingers.
products.story: Milled from Erode turmeric — the GI-tagged variety known for its colour.

products.name: Coriander Powder
products.desc: Freshly ground coriander with a sweet, citrusy aroma.
products.story: Ground from coriander seed bought in Ramganj Mandi, one of India's largest coriander markets.

products.name: Cumin Powder
products.desc: Aromatic cumin, ground from cleaned Unjha seed.
products.story: Milled from seed bought at Unjha — the market that sets cumin prices.

products.name: Onion Powder
products.desc: Dehydrated onion, milled into a free-flowing powder.
products.story: Mahuva in Gujarat is the centre of India's dehydrated onion and garlic industry.

products.name: Garlic Powder
products.desc: Dehydrated garlic with a strong, true-garlic flavour.
products.story: Produced in Mahuva's dehydration belt from Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh garlic.

products.name: Moringa Powder
products.desc: Vibrant green powder from shade-dried moringa leaves.
products.story: Milled from Tamil Nadu moringa leaves, dried in shade to protect colour and nutrients.
